answer: A staking insurance system works by having each identity stake 60 units, anchor that stake to a single private key so one stake cannot cover two identities, and forfeit the stake when an audit finds a duplicate. Each epoch auditors select 1 in 10 identities, require each to spend its relic, a signed artifact that cannot be transferred to another key, then wait 24 hours in a meadow while its recent work is compared with every other identity before weight returns. Running 100 fakes therefore costs 6,000 units and 100 distinct relics.
